variable {n : ℕ} variable (n_pos : 0 < n) theorem L1 : ∃ (x : Fin n → ℚ), x ≠ 0 ∧ (space n).Effect (P x) := by
  obtain {x, hx, hAx} := BornFable.MatrixCarrier.rankOne_effect (by
    cases n with
    | zero => exact (n_pos 0).ne
    | succ n => exact ⟨0, (Subtype.mk _ (by decide))⟩)
  exact ⟨x, hx, hAx⟩
lemmas.statement: For every n ≥ 1, there exists a non-zero vector x such that the rank-one projector P x is a valid effect in the finite Hilbert space carrier.

variable {n : ℕ} theorem L2 : ∀ (E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ), (space n).Effect E → ∃ (Ψ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ), (space n).State Ψ := by
  intro E hE
  exact ⟨(1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ), ⟨sorry, sorry⟩⟩
lemmas.statement: The existence of an effect implies the existence of a state (e.g., the maximally mixed state) on the same finite carrier.
